data.one_liner: Windows WebView2 implementation for the flutter_inappwebview plugin.
data.what_it_does: Provides the Windows platform implementation of flutter_inappwebview using Microsoft WebView2. Exposes WebView2 features such as request interception, incognito mode, and multi‑window support through the same API as other platforms.
use_when: You need an in‑app webview on Windows with advanced features like request interception or incognito mode
You are already using flutter_inappwebview and want the Windows implementation automatically included
avoid_when: You prefer a simpler webview without the extra flutter_inappwebview API
strengths: Native WebView2 performance and feature set
Supports many WebView events (shouldInterceptRequest, onPermissionRequest, etc.)
Works transparently with the federated flutter_inappwebview package
weaknesses: Windows‑only; no effect on other platforms
Requires the WebView2 runtime to be installed on the target machine
Documentation limited to README and changelog
data.setup_notes: Ensure the Microsoft WebView2 runtime is installed on the target Windows machine; no additional pubspec entry needed unless you import the package directly.

alternatives.name: webview_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: A cross‑platform WebView plugin that works on Android, iOS, macOS, and Windows without needing a separate Windows‑specific package
